corpus_accounting.reconciliation_note: All win rates (80/107 vs. SABRE O3; 100/107 vs. TKET) and physical observables are computed strictly over the 107 completed 3-way hardware benchmark jobs (321 compiled physical circuits, 4,964,352 completed physical shots). Three earlier 8Q Dense All-to-All queue dispatches (147,456 shots across 9 circuits) remained in PENDING_IN_QUEUE on an expired session and are listed separately in `unrecovered_queue_dispatches` for full ledger reconciliation (107 + 3 = 110).

observable_definitions.fidelity: Classical Computational-Basis Distribution Fidelity (Bhattacharyya Overlap): F_dist(P_ideal, P_meas) = sum_x sqrt(P_ideal(x) * P_meas(x)) over computational-basis bitstrings x in {0,1}^n, where P_ideal(x) is the noiseless ideal measurement probability and P_meas(x) is the empirical hardware bitstring frequency over 16,384 shots. Note: This is the classical computational-basis distribution overlap (square root of classical Hellinger fidelity), distinct from full 4^n quantum state tomography.
observable_definitions.tvd: Total Variation Distance: TVD(P_ideal, P_meas) = 0.5 * sum_x |P_ideal(x) - P_meas(x)| in [0, 1] (lower is better).
observable_definitions.hop: Heavy-Output Probability: HOP = sum_{x : P_ideal(x) > median(P_ideal)} P_meas(x). Methodological Note: Crossing the 2/3 (66.67%) heavy-output reference threshold on a specific deterministic workload (such as the 19Q Dense All-to-All K_19 benchmark on ibm_kingston, HOP = 70.45%) demonstrates heavy-output survival on that circuit, but is NOT a formal Quantum Volume (QV) certification, which requires Qiskit's random SU(4) model-circuit ensemble across >= 100 independent trials and a 2-sigma confidence bound.
observable_definitions.xeb: Linear Cross-Entropy Benchmarking score: (2^n) * sum_x P_ideal(x) * P_meas(x) - 1.
